race.title: luckytiger.co.uk Bet 20 Win 20 Wishing Well Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: None of the quartet can be ruled out but veteran KITTY'S LIGHT made a promising return from a long absence when an unlucky Fakenham fifth in May and gets the vote here off a handy-looking mark. Last year's victor Cadell could prove the chief danger ahead of Ki Woo . KITTY'S LIGHT CADELL (IRE) KI WOO (FR)
